descriptor: Product designer with a printable CV

voice.summary: Maren Okafor-Lind writes like a designer who edits hard: direct, specific and quietly confident. Every line shows what she did and what changed because of it.
dos: Start bullets with an action verb and an outcome
Use specific numbers where they exist
Keep to the sheet, one idea per line

taglines: Work you can check on a page
